title: 格温·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 亮蓝卷曲双马尾舒展开来，纽扣般眼饰呼应蓝黑荷叶边裙装。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Gwen is an adult doll-inspired woman with bright blue curled twin ponytails, a decorative button-like eye detail, and a blue-black frilled dress silhouette. Preserve her refined face and natural adult comic proportions, with a modest opaque bodice, long-sleeved blouse, opaque stockings, gloves, and shoes. Her enormous ornate scissors remain fully closed and held low beside her body, never cutting or raised.
art_direction.scene: A slightly elevated complete figure, asymmetric curved silhouette, naturally separated hands and a small sunlit ground cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: cobalt blue, ivory, teal, silver edge light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
